items.difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（11 行证明）、闭浸入后验相对循环条件：基变换与 i_* 交换引理化归约到 DVR + 闭纤维 pushforward 单射 + 特化交换引理，两步收。2 处引用全具名（compatibilities 为被拒卡但带真 tag 0H4P 作 stub，判例沿 0H6B），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-check-after-closed (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1060-1067

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Base change commutes with the pushforward i_*, so it suffices to check the defining specialization identity over a DVR base; there the two sides differ by the pushforward along the closed fibre, which is injective, and the pushforward commutes with the specialization map by the cited specialization-proper-pushforward lemma, giving the equivalence (source lines 1069-1079)
